body: The Dispatch 01 session: Casa's tracks are moving to a new cloud environment, so wrap up here and write your own handoff. 1) git fetch origin claude/main. Push any unpushed work on your branch. Don't start new build work. 2) At the end of your latest dispatch file (docs/dispatch/12-profile-pic-tracker.md), add a section "Handoff, 2026-10-13": where the work stands, your open PRs and what's left on them, what's next, gotchas, and anything waiting on Kimani or Casanova. Leave the roster and CLAUDE.md's table alone; Casanova updates them at merge. 3) In that section, write the restart kickoff for your successor session, from "Restarting a track in a new session" in docs/dispatch/README.md, naming your next work, which is Dispatch 12 (ledger line casa-r6-2), plus where Dispatch 01's parked stack (#41–#45) stands. 4) Open a docs-only PR to claude/main with it, and paste the restart kickoff back to Kimani in chat. Never merge. Sign "— the Dispatch 01 session". When the PR opens, mark Dispatch Ledger line casa-r7-4 delivered (rule 11).
summary: Write a handoff and the restart kickoff for the new environment.
title: Handoff: the Dispatch 01 session
